definitions.explanation: A small silver fish of the jack family, one of the commonest and cheapest fish in Japanese home cooking. Written {鯵|あじ} in kanji, but usually アジ in shops and recipes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アジフライ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's have fried horse mackerel tonight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧とれたアジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}かった→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、たたきにして⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Horse mackerel caught that morning was cheap, so I made tataki and the family ate it.

notes:
The katakana spelling keeps it apart from ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (taste), which has the same reading. Like many fish names it is written in katakana in biology and in shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アジフライ: breaded, deep-fried horse mackerel
- アジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: salted, dried horse mackerel (a breakfast staple)
- アジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たたき: finely chopped raw horse mackerel with ginger and scallion
- アジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け→南蛮漬け：27594_nanbanzuke⟧: fried horse mackerel marinated in vinegar
